text:
Berlin’s median asking rent sits at 15.18 €/m² in June 2026, a modest YoY decline of 2.0 % but still 29.5 % above the five‑year level. The city ranks 6th among the 37 most expensive German markets, with the 25th‑percentile at 10.38 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile at 19.98 €/m². Asking rents are almost double the existing rent (98 % premium) and a 60 m² unit costs about 911 € per month, representing a 20.9 % rent‑burden for two residents.

The market remains tight: vacancy is only 1.3 %, average days on market 26, and 38 % of listings are let within a week. Population growth of 3.9 % over five years adds pressure to supply.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to rise 7.0 % over the next 12 months, reaching 16.24 €/m², with a range of 15.42 – 16.73 €/m².
